title: Not sure it's worth the price
text: The idea of getting 2 new, QUALITY dog toys for my hard chewer sounded good. Add to that homemade-style gourmet dog goodies and $35 sounded like a decent price. But that's just the first box. Every month thereafter is $45 which puts the price of each dog toy at $15-$20. AND my dog was not impressed with the treats. I mean he ate them, but he didn't get as excited as for other treats I have. The toys do seem to be more resistant to destruction, but still... I think I will try one more month and then maybe call it quits.
label: neutral
